type Chan = { cap: int, len: int }

-- A fresh channel holding no elements.
make_chan(cap: int) -> Chan =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out.cap == cap
  post out.len == 0
  ex make_chan(2).cap == 2
  Chan(cap: cap, len: 0)

-- Attempts a non-blocking send. True if accepted, False if the channel was full.
try_send(var ch: Chan, v: int) -> bool uses nondet =
  pre ch.len >= 0
  pre ch.len <= ch.cap
  post ch.len <= ch.cap
  if ch.len < ch.cap
    ch.len += 1
    True
  else
    False

-- Sends each element of xs in order, stopping at the first refused send.
-- Returns how many sends were accepted.
accepted(cap: int, xs: List[int]) -> int uses nondet =
  pre cap >= 0
  post out >= 0
  post out <= xs.len()
  ex accepted(0, [1, 2]) == 0
  var ch = make_chan(cap)
  var n = 0
  for x in xs
    if try_send(&ch, x)
      n += 1
    else
      break
  n
